statements.text: In the wrong hands, AI tools and advanced microchips have the capacity to cause as much damage as [...] The United States’ microchip technology is well ahead of any of its competitors and allowing countries like Communist China to import such sensitive materials without oversight is reckless. We must make sure that these technologies stay out of the hands of our adversaries and ensure the United States remains at the forefront of the AI race.
statements.venue: Senate Banking Committee release, AI OVERWATCH Act

statements.text: Artificial Intelligence has the potential to profoundly change many aspects of our lives. As AI grows into an important tool for our national security, and a driver of economic growth, comprehensive public awareness and oversight is increasingly important. The commission proposed in this bill will provide guidance on how we cultivate AI to help ensure we stay ahead of countries like China in this space, while also building guardrails to make certain the U.S. government responsibly uses AI.
statements.venue: Senate press release, National Security Commission on AI bill with Sen. Ernst

statements.text: Technology, including AI, has advanced at a rapid pace in recent years, often making it difficult to ensure that rules and consumer protections keep pace with developments in the technology industry. An approach that combines strong protections for consumers while allowing the technology to thrive will allow the industry to solve problems, improve people’s lives, and ensure that all people enjoy the fruits of technological advancements in the 21st century.
statements.venue: Senate press release, letter to FTC on AI misuse

statements.text: Recently, deepfake technologies have been used to spoof the voices of leaders in other countries, to spread misinformation during democratic elections, and to confuse and defraud consumers. I’m introducing the Identifying Outputs of Generative Adversarial Networks Act so that we can understand how to better identify deepfake technology, devise comprehensive strategies to stop it and to ensure we’re educating Nevadans, and all Americans on ways they can protect themselves.
statements.venue: Senate press release, IOGAN Act deepfakes bill

statements.text:
Decades of discrimination have pushed down home values for Black Nevadans. That's unacceptable, and we have to close this gap.

As housing and rental companies begin to use AI models, I'm working in @SenateBanking to prevent AI from reinforcing housing bias and discrimination. https://t.co/aQ9yfN9lVh

I'm glad Pres. Trump signed our bipartisan TAKE IT DOWN Act today. We've seen how technology can deliver incredible innovations but there have to be guardrails to keep people safe.

That's why I supported this bill to protect and empower victims of real and deepfake revenge porn.

I’ve seen firsthand how technology can drive our economy and deliver incredible innovations, but we have to make sure that there are guardrails in place to keep people safe. I’m proud to support passage of this commonsense bipartisan law to protect and empower victims of real and deepfake revenge porn.
statements.venue: Senate press release on TAKE IT DOWN Act signing

statements.text: My priority is always to ensure Nevada families are protected, whether that’s from violent criminals or the dangers of AI. I’m proud to see that two of the bills I support that will keep Nevadans safe have been passed out of committee, and I will continue working with my colleagues across the aisle to ensure they become law.
statements.venue: Senate press release on GUARD Act (AI chatbots and minors) advancing in committee

statements.text:
Artificial intelligence capabilities are growing by the minute and America’s frontier AI companies are making billions every year. While these tools hold immense potential, Congress has a role to play to protect Americans from AI-enabled threats ranging from cybercrime to terrorism.

As this technology evolves, I will be working to ensure we have safeguards, protections for impacted workers, and that the American public is involved in this process that affects us all. (3/3)

I'm calling on Congressional leadership of both parties to hold AI safety hearings immediately. We need responsible policy that helps us compete with China while setting the global standard for commonsense guardrails on AI development and transparency. This can’t wait.

And, I'm pushing the Trump Admin. to restore and strengthen chip export controls that stop our adversaries from using American technology against us. I advocated for these controls to protect our national security, Trump should never have rolled them back. (2/3)

https://t.co/HDBqJIenge

AI development is moving quickly and the safety risks for Americans are also increasing every day. Congress and the U.S. AI industry must take the lead to address these threats while preserving American innovation. Especially since the President has made clear he has no intent to do anything to keep us safe. (1/3)
statements.quoted: President Trump rejects the idea of placing guardrails on artificial intelligence, saying in a Truth Social post that the only control needed is “a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” https://t.co/rbtwDmXVYy

statements.text: We need global standards for AI safety and transparency to protect workers, our families, and our national security. https://t.co/gE2d4qg8U9
